# 27. HMAC Rotation for Authnd Server and Clients

Date: 2021-07-01

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Since [early in its development](https://github.com/github/authnd/issues/52), all requests to the authnd API from internal services have been secured by a [HMAC](https://thehub.github.com/engineering/development-and-ops/secure-coding/secure-coding-general/service-to-service-auth/#how-to-implement-authentication-between-services) present in an authentication header.  Those HMACs are generated used a single HMAC key which is available to both the server and it's clients through Vault.  In the event of a security incident where that HMAC key were leaked, key rotation would necessarily require a service outtage to authnd's clients, because of the lag between when the new key is recognized by the server and subsequently adopted by the clients.  As we approach real production traffic, we need to gracefully handle HMAC key rotation to minimize the impact on our dependent services.

## Decision

We will introduce the ability to add multiple, comma-separated HMAC keys to our existing Vault secret, `AUTHND_HMAC_KEY`.  The authnd server will be modified to recognize a list of keys and accept any requests with HMACs generated by any of the provided keys; under normal conditions, the `AUTHND_HMAC_KEY` will contain a single value.  At a high level, the HMAC key rotation flow will follow these steps:

1. Generate the new HMAC key and append it to the `AUTHND_HMAC_KEY` value in the `authnd` vault.
2. Redeploy `authnd` to production to pickup the new `AUTHND_HMAC_KEY` value.
3. Verify the new HMAC key is supported by the server using sample requests with the authnd-cli.  _In order to facilitate this, the hmac chatop should be modified to use the last key in the list present in `AUTHND_HMAC_KEY`._
4. Work with our dependent services to:
    1. modify the `AUTHND_HMAC_KEY` value in their service's vault
    2. redeploy their service to pick up the new `AUTHND_HMAC_KEY`
5. In the `authnd` vault, replace the `AUTHND_HMAC_KEY` value with only the new HMAC key (i.e. remove any old values present in the list).

There will be a more exhaustive runbook for key rotation created as part of the [tracking issue](https://github.com/github/authnd/issues/972) for this change.

## Consequences

Authnd will be able to rotate HMAC keys to mitigate risk of future security incidents while maintaining availability for its dependent services.
